name: Close the M1.5 exit gate (cot re-evidence)
summary: The onboarding-rebuild milestone passed four of its five measured bars decisively. The one open bar — the sleeping cot being understood without prompting — was voided because the tester had been coached in earlier sessions. All the fixes it was waiting on (cot presentation, station pips, the yard rework) have since shipped; what's missing is a fresh adult.
requirements: One unprompted fresh-farm session by an adult who has never played, on the tablet
The cot bar scored from the session trace: at least one sleep, unprompted
No regression on the standing bars: dead taps ≤ 12% (current baseline 5%), longest honest stall ≤ 16.3s
Session recorded to playtests/ and verified against its autosave

Everything technical is ready: the build carries the cot dusk-glow, the purpose pips, and the yard rework, and the tablet has the current build. This session double-counts as the human artifact Replay Phase B needs.
